summary: Groww drops the socket: the feed mints a new socket token, reconnects, sends CONNECT again and resubscribes with sid 1; the first tick of the new session (an LTP and a fresh volume) carries only what it says, never the old session's OHLC.

notes: The fake socket does not echo the nats subprotocol, so each connect is two connections: the first asks for it and is dropped by the feed, the second goes without it (GrowwFeed::on_connect_failed, web nats_websocket.py subprotocol fallback). Connection 2 is the session.

The socket token comes from the fake broker API (env.serve_json in tests/it/feed_corpus/groww.rs, GrowwBroker::with_feed_endpoints). INFO carries no nonce, so CONNECT is the jwt-only form; the signed form is pinned by tests/it/broker_groww_feed.rs, which checks the nonce signature.

deviations.reason: The web client reconnects on its own and resubscribes, but the adapter's merge cache is cleared only on a disconnect of the adapter, so the first tick of the new session is published with the old session's close. The desktop starts every connection afresh (GrowwFeed::on_connected; CLAUDE.md: a cached market field belongs to the session that sent it).
